caseName: Delgado v. Summit Ridge Hospitality, LLC (No. 25-cv-0442, fictional)

facts.text: Delgado was hired as a floor manager at the Summit Ridge lodge.

source.quote: Plaintiff was hired as a floor manager on March 3, 2020.

facts.text: Delgado was hired as a floor manager and completed onboarding that week.

source.quote: Defendant admits Plaintiff was hired as a floor manager on March 3, 2020.

facts.text: Reyes gave Delgado a written warning about cash-handling procedures.

source.quote: I gave her a written warning about the cash drawer on December first.

facts.text: Delgado never received any written or verbal warning during her employment.

source.quote: No one ever gave me a written or verbal warning in almost five years.

facts.text: Reyes told Delgado her employment was terminated at the end of the shift.

source.quote: On January 9, 2025, Mr. Reyes told Ms. Delgado she was terminated, effective at the end of her shift.

facts.text: Delgado's employment was terminated by letter dated January 10, 2025.

source.quote: This letter confirms the termination of your employment, effective January 10, 2025.

facts.text: Summit Ridge paid Delgado's final wages by check on January 15, 2025, omitting accrued vacation pay.

source.quote: Defendant issued final wages on January 15, 2025, but did not include accrued vacation pay.

facts.text: Delgado filed this action alleging wrongful termination and unpaid wages.

source.quote: Plaintiff files this Complaint on February 6, 2025.

facts.text: The cash-handling policy posted in the back office was never updated after 2021.

source.quote: The policy on the wall was the same one from 2021 the whole time I worked there.

facts.text: Summit Ridge rolled out a new cash-handling policy to all locations.

source.quote: We rolled the new cash policy out to all locations in spring of 2024.
